development_evidence.population: opened ORN v3 + opened ORN v4 lockboxes after ORN v5 freeze

version_rationale.earlier_version: ORN v4 mel candidate used min_confidence 0.75 with default decode thresholds and reached lockbox F1 0.798517 (recall-limited).
version_rationale.earlier_limitation: Match/copy recall was the shortfall; development on v3 alone did not expose the need for slightly lower confidence with softer boundary splitting.
version_rationale.later_change: After sealing v5, grid mel min_confidence and small decode overrides on pooled opened v3+v4; select conf=0.72 with boundary_threshold=0.42 and strong_rearticulation=0.58.
version_rationale.comparable_result: Pooled development F1 0.807944 with recall 0.827528 and precision 0.789265.
version_rationale.status: frozen for one-shot ORN v5 evaluation; no ORN v5 target or key has been read
